items.t: SoundHound AI Stock Forecast: How Much Upside Do Analysts See Post-Q3 Earnings?
items.sum: U.S.-based voice AI company SoundHound AI (SOUN) reported better-than-expected Q3 2026 results, with revenue rising 48.5% year-over-year to a record $62.4 million. This topped Wall Street’s estimate of $61.71 million. The company also reported an adjusted loss of $0.05 per share, narrower than analysts’ expected loss of $0.13.
